hero.filename: Chris Chow interviews Emil de Guzman for the documentary "Fall of the I-Hotel".jpg
hero.caption: Chris Chow (r) interviews Emil de Guzman, the head of the International Hotel Tenants Association for the documentary, "Fall of the I-Hotel" the day after the tenants were evicted from the hotel August 4, 1977, 848 Kearny Street, San Francisco.
